name: Dornune Asheth
keeps: what one world owes another and has not said
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: Refused to plead, so there was no conviction and no forfeiture.
text: Dornune asheth of the quiet lamp, carries between for the 3rd tranche, doors 20 to 28. Keeps what one world owes another and has not said. Reads Giles Corey.
